purpose: Map a fixed Zeta train prefix to the one-line action contract; diagnostic only
dataset_license: Apache-2.0 metadata, with original source-file rights unresolved per row
rule: Require one marked editable region, same path and byte-exact outside-region content, a single physical-line insert/replace/delete, and exact action replay; no repair or target truncation
acceptance: No training label can be accepted without source repository and file-license resolution, history reconstruction, group split, and independent task objective
success_gate_for_further_work: At least 40 exact one-line mappings in 100 rows and at least one mapping in each of Python, TypeScript, Rust, Go; even a pass is insufficient to train
